Pixel Studio built-in extensions v0.4

These are independent browser implementations of publicly described functions.
They are not official ports, do not bundle the original authors' Lua code or
assets, and cannot load .aseprite-extension packages. Original plugin names are
used to identify the user-requested references. No affiliation is claimed.

ISO Box — darkwark
https://darkwark.itch.io/isobox-for-aseprite
Browser: 2:1 boxes, side colors, highlights, outlines, corner variants, wireframe.
Corner rasterization and dimensions may differ from the original Lua script.

Magic Pencil — Kacper Woźniak
https://thkaspar.itch.io/magic-pencil
Browser: outline/graffiti brushes, connected-shape outline, lift/merge/select,
RGB/HSV mixing, weighted mixing, hue/color/saturation/value and palette limiting.
No magic foreground/background color protocol or right-click-dependent modes.

Animation Suite — Kacper Woźniak
https://thkaspar.itch.io/animation-suite
Browser: source layer/frame range/current selection, static/linear/sine motion,
multi-layer periods with LCM loop. Aseprite tags are not retained by the importer;
use the corresponding frame range instead. Maximum 240 frames / 8M pixels.

Snap Selection — kid marscat
https://kidmarscat.itch.io/snapselection
Browser: rectangle and painted selection, outward grid snap with offsets,
move/copy/extract selected pixels. Pixel content moves only on explicit apply.

Normal Shading — Mooosik
https://mooosik.itch.io/shading-extension
Browser: Blinn–Phong directional, ambient and specular lighting, source normal
layer or imported map, optional specular map, Y flip, current/all-frame output.
View direction is fixed toward +Z. Rendering is not bit-for-bit equivalent.

References inspected 2026-10-11. Public availability/download pricing alone is
not a redistribution license; original packages were not redistributed.
